text: Do not repeat the tactics which have gained you one victory, but let your methods be regulated by the infinite variety of circumstances.
author: Sun Tzu

archive.text: We can only see a short distance ahead, but we can see plenty there that needs to be done.
archive.author: Alan Turing

archive.text: Even kings and emperors with heaps of wealth and vast dominion cannot compare with an ant filled with the love of God.
archive.author: Guru Nanak

archive.text: When you begin to touch your heart or let your heart be touched, you begin to discover that it's bottomless.
archive.author: Pema Chodron

archive.text: The world is but a canvas to the imagination.
archive.author: Henry David Thoreau

archive.text: The day I am not able to fly will be a sad day for me.
archive.author: Ratan Tata

archive.text: Control thy passions lest they take vengeance on thee.
archive.author: Epictetus

archive.text: Great minds discuss ideas; average minds discuss events; small minds discuss people.
archive.author: Eleanor Roosevelt
